answer: Assume the operator takes the shortest path, so the edge that vouches for a new account starts at half weight and decays unless the account does work. Attestation earnings are capped per identity per epoch, which removes the reason to spin up a second pulse of accounts for the same seat. A quorum has to span unrelated subnetworks, so two agents behind one mesa router cannot fill it. Everything else is a jetty you rebuild each epoch; keep the account working and the edge stays.
